lemmas.primary_translation: to be knocked down so hard that one is left lying / to take a short break

definitions.text: bli slått i bakken så hardt at en blir liggende
definitions.translation: to be knocked to the ground so hard that one is left lying there (lit. to take a count)

examples.no: spilleren gikk rett i isen og måtte ta telling
examples.en: the player went straight down onto the ice and had to take a count

examples.no: spilleren måtte ta telling på benken etter taklingen
examples.en: the player had to take a short break on the bench after the tackle
